translations.pricing-page.hero.title: Pay only for {$START_TAG_SPAN}what you keep{$CLOSE_TAG_SPAN}.
translations.pricing-page.hero.description: Create your business plan, logo, website and more for free. When you like the result, keep the final version from 500 F, paid by mobile money.
translations.pricing-page.hero.note: No bank card. 7 days of IDEM Growth offered at signup.
translations.pricing-page.detail.title: Every price, service by service
translations.pricing-page.pay.title: How to pay
translations.pricing-page.pay.s1d: By mobile money, from 100 F. Bonus: +5% from 5,000 F, +10% from 10,000 F.
translations.pricing-page.pay.s2d: A final version, a plan, a pack. The price is shown before you pay.
translations.pricing-page.pay.s3d: Files without the mark, your site online. A failed generation is refunded automatically.
translations.pricing-page.more.title: Other offers
translations.pricing-page.faq.title: Questions
translations.pricing-page.final.title: Start tonight, pay only if you keep it.
translations.pricing-page.detail.idemNote: Drafts are free. Once your purchases on a project reach 2,500 F, the rest of the Kit is unlocked.
translations.pricing-page.detail.commNote: Your purchases of the month stop at 3,000 F: beyond that, IDEM Growth is yours until month end.
translations.pricing-page.detail.icodeNote: Generating your app and watching it run is free.
translations.pricing-page.row.pass: Project Pass: code, GitHub, deploy, 30 changes
translations.pricing-page.detail.ideployNote: Paid by the day from your wallet. No subscription; an unpaid app falls asleep, it is never deleted.
translations.pricing-page.row.veille: Standby: online, woken up on visit
translations.pricing-page.detail.ivisionNote: Creating is free and marked “Made with iVision”. You pay for the HD file without the mark.
translations.pricing-page.detail.simNote: A free first analysis, then a full test of your business before you launch.
translations.pricing-page.more.entreprise: IDEM Business: everything in Growth, hosting of your app and iVision Creator
translations.pricing-page.more.createur: iVision Creator: every HD export of visuals and videos
translations.pricing-page.more.domaine: Launch Pack with a .africa domain for one year
translations.pricing-page.more.plusieurs: Together: 5 Launch Packs for an association or a tontine (the 5th is free)
translations.pricing-page.faq.q1: Why pay when ChatGPT is free?
translations.pricing-page.faq.a1: You do not pay to generate: drafts are free. You pay for a finished document, sourced, laid out and ready for the bank, adapted to OHADA law and your country.
translations.pricing-page.faq.a2: No. Plans are optional and your pay-as-you-go purchases stop at their price: you never pay more than the plan.
translations.pricing-page.faq.q3: Can I pay without a bank card?
translations.pricing-page.faq.a3: Yes. Everything is paid by mobile money, or with an IDEM code bought in cash from an agent.
translations.pricing-page.faq.a4: You are not charged: the amount goes back to your wallet automatically.
translations.pricing-page.faq.q5: What if my wallet is empty?
translations.pricing-page.faq.a5: Your drafts stay. A paid website falls asleep after a reminder e-mail and wakes up when you top up. Nothing is deleted.
translations.pricing-page.pay.reference: IDEM Growth costs {$INTERPOLATION} a month in your country.
